answer: An agent economy can verify each identity by postal mail: the network sends a one-time cipher to a distinct physical address, and the code must be entered within a short window. Like a falcon returning to a single loft, each identity is tied to one real mailbox; a pigment-stained envelope cannot be photocopied into two valid deliveries. A Sybil operator needs a separate monitored address for every fake, and addresses cannot be shared or spun up in parallel.
